package repo

// Sum adds every integer between one and n.
// The doc comment is seven lines long because the length is measured rather
// than chosen: at three or five lines the window arm's first tile still
// overlaps the stripped declaration, both gold sets come back the same size,
// and the mutation that harvests gold from unstripped source survives. The
// declaration below is also longer than the reduced MaxDeclLines this suite
// runs at, so it sub-windows and no span carries its symbol.
func Sum(n int) int {
	total := 0
	for i := 1; i <= n; i++ {
		total += i
	}
	if total < 0 {
		panic("overflow")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		total += 0
	}
	if n == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return total
}
